title: DIL SE KABHI NA SHAAM KE MANZER JUDAA HOVEY
body:
DIL SE KABHI NA SHAAM KE MANZER JUDAA HOVEY
SAJJAD KAB GHAMOUN SE YEH PALBHAR JUDA HOVEY
1. BABA KO YAAD KAR KE WOH ROOTEY HAI HAR GHADI
SAJJAD SE KABHI BHI NAA SARWAR JUDA HOVEY
<<DIVIDER>>
2. RAHOUN MEIB SAATH SAATH THE NAZROUN KE SAMNE
KAISE BHULAYEIN JISMOUN SE JO SAR JUDA HOVEY
<<DIVIDER>>
3. SAJJAD KE LABOO PE SADAYEIN YEHI RAHI
KARBOBALA MEIN SAB MERE DILBAR JUDA HOVEY
<<DIVIDER>>
4. ZANJEER MEIN THEY JAKDE HOVEY DEKH THEY RAHEY
MAA O SE JO SAFAR MEIN YEH DILBAR JUDA HOVEY
<<DIVIDER>>
5. SAJJAD SAR KO PEET KE KHEHTEY THEY BASYAHI
AKBER JUDA HOVEY ALI ASGHAR JUDA HOVEY
<<DIVIDER>>
6. KARBAL KI PYAAS HAR GHADI AHSAAS MEIN RAHI
BIMAAR KE NA DIL SE BAHATAR JUDA HOVEY
